task.title: Adjusting Volume and Using Bass Boost Button
task.shortdesc: Adjusting the audio of your car radio, your connected devices, and utilizing the Bass Boost Button improves the quality of sound and provides bass music quality.

context.p: To obtain the best volume and audio quality, a baseline audio needs to be set and the bass boost button on the device can be used to improve the richness of sound as it plays through the car's radio.

step.info: A baseline volume level refers to an optimal, undistorted sound level, which can be achieved by adjusting volume of the car's radio and/or the connected device.

substep.cmd: Adjust the volume of the car radio to 1/3 or 1/2 of its capacity. To avoid audio distortion or static sound, do not exceed 2/3.
If using Bluetooth Mode, adjust the volume of the connected mobile or electronic device to 2/3 or 4/5 of its sound capacity. Do not set connected device to full volume.

step.info: This button can be used to give audio a stronger bass, creating a more dynamic sound effect through the car's radio.

substep.cmd: Locate the Bass Button on the device

image.alt: Image of Bass Booster Button labeled on transmitter

substep.note: Long press Bass Booster 1x to turn ON/OFF the Ring Light on the transmitter device.
substep.cmd: Short Press the button 1x while music is playing to activate.
substep.info: Short pressing 1x again will turn off Bass Booster

step.note: Play music or sound for this step to accurately adjust volume
step.cmd: Toggle the volume up/down on the device using the Multi-Function joystick to fine-tune the volume on the transmitter

image.alt: Image of multi-function button showing the toggle of device volume up/down

result.p: After completing these steps, the sound playing through your car's radio should be at its optimal audio quality.
